name: 각진 기하 면분할
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. One single full-body 2D character asset on a genuinely transparent background.
Input image1 is the ONLY authority for character design, body proportions, face/head-to-body ratio, exact pose and camera. Restyle this exact model; retain its longer adult illustration body, smaller relative head, long torso and limbs.
STYLE IS THE MAIN CHANGE: Entire character rendered in angular polygonal triangular 2D mosaic planes: dozens of sharp straight-edged facets on face, hair, armor and cloth. No round painted modeling, no contour ink, no glass lead lines, no paper shadows. Flat shaded polygon illustration, no 3D render.
Keep the right-facing FRONT THREE-QUARTER combat-ready pose exactly: same head/body yaw, bent knees, planted spread feet, same elbow/hand positions and weapon angles. Right hand holds ONE long sword forward diagonally up-right, left hand holds ONE short angular dagger near chest up-right. Preserve blond layered spiky hair, brown eyes/youthful male identity; silver armor, blue scarf and short lowered hood (no long cape), blue waistcloth, brown belt/pouches/trousers. Anatomical RIGHT crescent pauldron and plated shin are screen-left/near side; LEFT blue cloth boot remains screen-right. Longsword blue diagonal blade inlays, wing-shaped guard and ring knuckle guard remain recognizable within this medium; dagger stays short/angular. No extra arms/weapons/accessories; hands actually wrap handles, wrist/guard/blade axes connected.
Preserve the input silhouette, head size and body lengths rather than redesigning anatomy for style. All hair, boots, sword/dagger tips must fit inside with modest clear margins. ONLY ONE character, no lettering, no labels, no floor, no background decorations or paper sheet. Medium texture applies to the figure only. Replace original shading completely with specified medium; a small color filter over the same anime painting is unacceptable.
outputHint:
Generated images are saved to C:\Users\user\.codex\generated_images\01a1bf68-4705-71f0-9449-07a1041b38d9 as C:\Users\user\.codex\generated_images\01a1bf68-4705-71f0-9449-07a1041b38d9\exec-82d7b67e-a3e0-4f8e-b965-15e193fa8b99.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
